title: Symphonic Metal
tagline: A grand, orchestral frame around a driving metal song.
summary: Symphonic metal blends heavy rock with strings, choirs and dramatic arrangements, creating a more theatrical sound than most forms of metal. The style often pairs detailed composition with soaring melodies, allowing the voice and the arrangement to carry the same emotional weight.

pillars.name: Nightwish
pillars.why: Nightwish made the combination of operatic vocals and metal rhythm a durable and widely recognizable form.

pillars.name: Within Temptation
pillars.why: Within Temptation balanced melodic clarity with a more modern, polished production style.

pillars.name: Therion
pillars.why: Therion brought a deliberately grand, orchestral dimension to the genre and expanded its ambition.
